plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git workflow commands: commit, commit-push, commit-push-pr, clean-gone, cherry-pick, and merge

plugins.name: test-driven-fix
plugins.description: Autonomously fix failing tests by iterating patch → test → revert-on-regression, with a 10-iteration cap

plugins.name: respond-to-review
plugins.description: Respond to every flagged issue on a PR — inline comments and review-body findings — dismissing false positives and fixing valid ones

plugins.name: code-review-AT
plugins.description: Multi-specialist code review of a PR via a sub-agent team

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Multi-specialist code review of a PR using parallel native subagents (no agent team, no SDK)

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Audit project docs (CLAUDE.md, READMEs, .claude/commands, .claude/skills, architecture docs) for stale claims about the codebase and report findings with suggested fixes

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Adversarial debate on a claim. Pro and con subagents generate opening arguments then attack and defend across up to 5 rounds; orchestrator renders an inline markdown report of surviving, negated, and disputed arguments.

plugins.name: simplify
plugins.description: Propose and apply targeted simplifications to recently modified code while preserving behavior

plugins.name: transcript
plugins.description: Print the filepath of the current Claude Code session's .jsonl transcript with size and line count

plugins.name: jira-ticket
plugins.description: Generate a structured JIRA ticket (summary, acceptance criteria, QA testing steps) from a diff, PR, or description and file it in JIRA after confirmation

plugins.name: jira-implement
plugins.description: Take a JIRA ticket by key, understand its intent, verify every claim it makes about the codebase to catch false positives, design an implementation plan (reconciling any solution the ticket proposed with one designed independently), present it for approval, then implement.

plugins.name: tool-discipline
plugins.description: PreToolUse guardrails: block cd-chaining, prefer built-in Read/Write/Edit over cat/head/tail/sed, and conditionally redirect ToolSearch loads of Grep/Glob to the embedded ripgrep/ugrep/bfs Bash search on native builds that dropped them (self-disabling elsewhere)

plugins.name: tool-discipline-lsp
plugins.description: LSP navigation guardrails: push Go/TS symbol searches to the LSP tool (PreToolUse), plus a PostToolUse advisory nudging a retry when workspaceSymbol returns empty
